::: {style="font-size: 2em;"}
Outreach
:::

::: {style="font-size: 1.5em;"}
Participatory Science Projects:
:::

::: {style="text-align: center;"}
Crowd the Tap (NCSU) - This country-wide citizen science project
concerned detection of lingering or unreported lead pipe infrastructure,
particularly in the homes and schools of marginalized groups. The
project goal included increasing equitable access to safe drinking water
by generating water quality data through collaboration with individuals,
high school classes, HBCU alumni, and faith communities.

Native Orchid Growth (Smithsonian Environmental Research Center) - This
Maryland-based project was centered around the growth of native orchid
species. We brought materials for growing orchids with thier fungal
partners or with fertilizer to local schools and coached them on how to
monitor growth and handle scientific data.

Self-led Field Trip Guide (New River Gorge National Park) - This
site-based mini-curriculum for upper elementary school park visitors
allows students to contribute to the park’s preservation and
conservation efforts as citizen scientists.
:::
